title: Added a built-in XLSX engine, so `importFile: true` and `exportFile: true` read and write `.xlsx` files without ExcelJS; `engines: { xlsx: ExcelJS }` keeps working. Fixed `updateSettings({ mergeCells: [] })` and `customBorders` throwing after a `loadData`/`updateData` that shrank the grid, an XLSX export freezing extra columns or rows when some were hidden, an empty checkbox exporting as `FALSE`, the Formulas plugin losing a validated write when `updateSettings()` ran in the same task, and `removeCellMeta()` throwing for an index past the grid's range (it now removes the key at that physical index, like `setCellMeta()`).
